requirements.text: Connector exposes an authenticated receipt-status-update endpoint for Trilogy; supports digital and printed receipts; required fields validated before processing.
Request accepts Player ID, Receipt ID, receipt status and status transaction date.
Supports Issued, Redeemed, Voided via an extensible status contract; unknown/unsupported values are rejected.
Receipt located by Receipt ID + player association; only the matching receipt updated; supplied transaction date stored with the status; sibling receipts of the same player unaffected.
A newly stored receipt can be Issued (digital and printed); an Issued, unexpired receipt remains eligible for the receipt-list API (#1445171) per the property Technical Setting.
Valid redemption update sets Redeemed and persists the redemption date; Redeemed excluded from the available list (digital and printed); Redeemed cannot revert to Issued.
Valid void update sets Voided and persists the void date; Voided excluded from the available list (digital and printed); Voided cannot revert to Issued.

Transitions validated against approved lifecycle rules; invalid transitions rejected and logged; older updates cannot overwrite a newer terminal status; out-of-order updates do not revert the lifecycle.
Identical repeated updates are idempotent: no new receipt, no corrupted status, approved result returned when the status is already applied.
Unknown Receipt ID returns the approved not-found response; Player/Receipt mismatch rejected; invalid status or dates rejected; failures use the standard Connector API error format.
Failed updates return a retryable response; success is never reported unless persisted; a later successful retry yields the correct final state.

Updated status available to the receipt-list API (#1445171) after persistence; Redeemed/Voided excluded under Digital Only and All Receipts; Connector does not call Trilogy when evaluating availability.

requirements.source: Wiki: Receipt Content Ingestion & Status Update API
requirements.text: Contract: POST /{siteId}/api/v1/player/receipt, headers x-evri-meta + x-evri-tenantid, body {receiptIdentifier, receiptStatus, transactionDate}; 200 on success; 400 TGO-CNT014 Invalid Tenant, TGO-CNT027 Invalid Meta, TGO-CNT039 already redeemed, TGO-CNT038 receipt does not exist, TGO-CNT040 transaction date after expiration date, TGO-CNT034 missing required fields.
Have an offset of 5 minutes during the receipt status update.
This item does not create receipts, does not deliver notifications and does not send status directly to EPG; integration direction is Trilogy -> Connector.
CXP redemption / Trilogy void triggers Trilogy to call the Connector status API with the actual transaction date; the voucher/receipt is then excluded from list/detail results.

business_rules: BR-1: Receipt lifecycle is Issued -> Redeemed or Issued -> Voided; Redeemed and Voided are terminal and never revert to Issued (AC6, AC7, AC8).
BR-2: Only the receipt matching Receipt ID + player association is updated (AC4).
BR-3: Supplied status transaction date is persisted with the status (AC4, AC6, AC7).
BR-4: An older update cannot overwrite a newer terminal status (AC8).
BR-5: Repeating an identical update is idempotent (AC9).
BR-6: Redeemed and Voided receipts are excluded from the available list under Digital Only and All Receipts (AC12).
BR-7: Transaction date must not be after the receipt expiration date (Wiki TGO-CNT040).
BR-8: A 5-minute offset applies during status update (Development Refinement) - semantics unconfirmed.
functional_requirements: Status values Issued/Redeemed/Voided; unsupported values rejected.
Correct-receipt location and persistence of status + transaction date.
Standard error format and documented error codes.
non_functional_requirements: Security: tenant/meta authentication, cross-tenant and cross-player isolation, injection resistance, no sensitive data in errors.
Reliability/Recovery: no false success, retry-safe, concurrency-safe.
Performance: sustained Trilogy update throughput (SLA not specified).
dependencies: #1365562 Store Player Receipt Content and Metadata (receipt must exist).
#1445168 Module Receipt Ingestion (creates receipts for test setup).
#1445171 Expose Player Receipt List API (consumes stored status).
#1470269 Ingest CXP Receipt Redeem Status (Trilogy caller for redemptions).
Property Technical Setting: Digital Only / All Receipts.
constraints: Single route /{siteId}/api/v1/player/receipt serves both ingestion and status update (both documented as POST).
Connector must not call Trilogy/PKMS when evaluating availability.
No notifications and no direct EPG calls from this item.
assumptions: Player identity is conveyed by x-evri-meta (the documented status-update body has no Player ID field).
Status-update requests are distinguished from ingestion by body shape (3 fields) on the shared POST route.
transactionDate equal to expirationDate is accepted; only strictly-after is rejected with TGO-CNT040.
The 5-minute offset is a clock-skew tolerance allowing transactionDate up to 5 minutes in the future.
Duplicate Redeemed returns 400 TGO-CNT039 as the 'approved result' referenced by AC9.

test_conditions.text: Valid authenticated request updates digital and printed receipts.
Missing/invalid tenant or meta header is rejected (CNT014/CNT027).
Missing/empty/null required fields rejected with CNT034 before processing.
All four data elements are accepted and used.
Only the matching receipt is updated and the date stored exactly.
New receipts are Issued and eligible in the list when unexpired.
Redeemed transition, persistence, exclusion, no revert.
Voided transition, persistence, exclusion, no revert.
Not-found, mismatch, invalid values rejected in standard error format.
Failure responses are retryable and never false-success.
List availability reflects stored status across settings without calling Trilogy.
Documented route, method, headers, media type and error codes honoured.
No receipt creation, notifications or EPG calls.

traceability_matrix.requirement: Connector exposes an authenticated receipt-status-update endpoint for Trilogy; supports digital and printed receipts; required fields validated before processing.
Request accepts Player ID, Receipt ID, receipt status and status transaction date.
Supports Issued, Redeemed, Voided via an extensible status contract; unknown/unsupported values are rejected.
Receipt located by Receipt ID + player association; only the matching receipt updated; supplied transaction date stored with the status; sibling receipts of the same player unaffected.
A newly stored receipt can be Issued (digital and printed); an Issued, unexpired receipt remains eligible for the receipt-list API (#1445171) per the property Technical Setting.
Valid redemption update sets Redeemed and persists the redemption date; Redeemed excluded from the available list (digital and printed); Redeemed cannot revert to Issued.
Valid void update sets Voided and persists the void date; Voided excluded from the available list (digital and printed); Voided cannot revert to Issued.

Transitions validated against approved lifecycle rules; invalid transitions rejected and logged; older updates cannot overwrite a newer terminal status; out-of-order updates do not revert the lifecycle.
Identical repeated updates are idempotent: no new receipt, no corrupted status, approved result returned when the status is already applied.
Unknown Receipt ID returns the approved not-found response; Player/Receipt mismatch rejected; invalid status or dates rejected; failures use the standard Connector API error format.
Failed updates return a retryable response; success is never reported unless persisted; a later successful retry yields the correct final state.

Updated status available to the receipt-list API (#1445171) after persistence; Redeemed/Voided excluded under Digital Only and All Receipts; Connector does not call Trilogy when evaluating availability.

Contract: POST /{siteId}/api/v1/player/receipt, headers x-evri-meta + x-evri-tenantid, body {receiptIdentifier, receiptStatus, transactionDate}; 200 on success; 400 TGO-CNT014 Invalid Tenant, TGO-CNT027 Invalid Meta, TGO-CNT039 already redeemed, TGO-CNT038 receipt does not exist, TGO-CNT040 transaction date after expiration date, TGO-CNT034 missing required fields.
traceability_matrix.source: Wiki: Receipt Content Ingestion & Status Update API

traceability_matrix.requirement: Have an offset of 5 minutes during the receipt status update.
This item does not create receipts, does not deliver notifications and does not send status directly to EPG; integration direction is Trilogy -> Connector.
CXP redemption / Trilogy void triggers Trilogy to call the Connector status API with the actual transaction date; the voucher/receipt is then excluded from list/detail results.

missing_requirements: No documented lifecycle rule for terminal-to-terminal transitions (Redeemed <-> Voided); cases TC-035/TC-036 assume rejection.

Approved not-found / mismatch / invalid-transition error codes are not listed separately in the wiki (only TGO-CNT038/039 exist); confirm codes for Player/Receipt mismatch and Voided-related rejections.
Retry contract with Trilogy (which HTTP statuses are retryable, retry count/backoff) is not documented.
No performance SLA (throughput/latency) for the status endpoint.
Logging format/fields for rejected transitions are not specified.
Wiki status-update body has no Player ID field while AC2 requires Player ID - confirm source (x-evri-meta assumed).

ambiguous_requirements.issue: Development Refinement 'offset of 5 minutes during the receipt update status' does not say what is offset (future-date tolerance, expiration comparison, or out-of-order window).
ambiguous_requirements.assumption_made: transactionDate may be up to 5 minutes ahead of server time; beyond that it is rejected (TC-063/TC-064).

ambiguous_requirements.issue: AC9 says duplicates return 'the approved result', while the wiki returns 400 TGO-CNT039 for already-redeemed receipts; no equivalent code is documented for already-voided.
ambiguous_requirements.assumption_made: Duplicate Redeemed -> 400 TGO-CNT039; duplicate Voided -> consistent approved result (code to confirm).

ambiguous_requirements.issue: Ingestion and status update are both documented as POST on the same route; the discriminator between them is not specified.
ambiguous_requirements.assumption_made: Body shape (3-field status body) selects the status-update path (TC-061).

ambiguous_requirements.issue: Whether transactionDate equal to expirationDate is 'after' the expiration date.
ambiguous_requirements.assumption_made: Equality is accepted; strictly after is rejected with TGO-CNT040 (TC-050/TC-051).

ambiguous_requirements.issue: Case sensitivity / whitespace handling of receiptStatus not specified.
ambiguous_requirements.assumption_made: Either normalized to canonical value or rejected - never stored non-canonically (TC-017).
